description: Agent Delegation: submit a delegation’s return flow: whether the original brief is kept with what counts as done, what returned work is checked against (the brief, the delegate’s own report, or nothing) and by whom (the delegator, an independent checker, the delegate itself, or no one), whether the check comes before the work is accepted, paid for and passed on, and what happens to work that fails (sent back with the reasons, escalated, redone by the delegator, dropped without a word, or accepted anyway), plus optionally the returns seen with whether each was checked and passed, the criteria it missed and whether it was accepted, paid for or passed on. The signed report says whether the delegator verifies returned work against the original brief before accepting it, paying for it or passing it on, and what happens to work that fails, and names no check, a check by the delegate or against its own report, no brief kept, every use before the check, failed work accepted, every return used unchecked and every failed return used, then a brief with no criteria, failed work redone by the delegator or dropped without a word and every return passed with criteria unmet, with the fix for each. This reads acceptance of a delegate’s work inside a delegation: one paid call’s result against its order is wever_result-validation-check, a job’s work against acceptance criteria is wever_deliverable-check and who holds a task between send and acceptance is wever_handoff-acceptance-check. Verdict accepted_unchecked, result_gaps, result_unverified or checked_against_brief. POST /api/delegation-result-check. Reads only the material in the call: no network request, fetch, money movement, message, sharing, configuration change or external write. Paid URL: 0.10 USDC per call on Base via x402 exact, with the shared 10 signed-wallet free calls per rolling 30 days. Bind X-Wever-Wallet-Proof to the exact JSON arguments and the tool route. Returns a report with an Ed25519 signed receipt. Contract: /api/agent-delegation-contract. Human page: https://weverlabs.com/agent-delegation/.

criteria.description: What the brief says counts as done, such as a source cited for every figure.

kept.description: The original brief is kept with the delegation, so returned work can be checked against it.

against.description: What returned work is checked against: the original brief, the delegate’s own report of what it did, or nothing.

before_accept.description: The check comes before the work is accepted.

before_pass_on.description: The check comes before the work is passed on to the principal or another agent.

before_pay.description: The check comes before the delegate is paid.

by.description: Who checks it: the delegator, a checker independent of the delegate, the delegate itself, or no one.

on_fail.description: What happens to work that fails: sent back with the reasons, escalated to the principal, redone by the delegator, dropped without a word, or accepted anyway.

flow.description: The return flow, such as research briefs from the analyst agent.

label.description: Optional name recorded in the report.

returns.description: Returns seen, with whether each was checked and how it was used.

checked.description: This return was checked against the brief before it was used.

paid.description: The delegate was paid for it.

passed_on.description: It was passed on to the principal or another agent.

name: wever_delegation-result-check
title: Delegation result check
